grammar.title: निषेधको दायरा
grammar.explain: Nepali combines postpositions and case markers, honorific agreement, aspect and evidentiality, participles, SOV order, topic-focus particles, Devanagari spelling, and prosody. Choices encode participant roles, evidence, focus, and social relationship.

examples.t: देखिएका सबै सुधार वास्तविक प्रगति होइनन्; केही नतिजाले भार मात्र पुनर्वितरण गर्छन्।
